retained_rows.assessment_basis: The sexual synthetic likeness and documented dignity/privacy consequences make the AI-lifecycle rights/autonomy proposition materially relevant. The source-to-output/requester chain, actual generating actor, consent context and production date are unestablished. The interim press-law decision permits reporting a distribution suspicion; it does not resolve who generated the material or that actor’s production authority. The independent alignment finding remains Boundary, without requiring a proven hidden taxonomy mechanism, treating other cases as occurrence evidence or deciding criminal responsibility.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The occurrence’s alleged AI-generated sexual identity portrayal and source-grounded dignity/privacy consequences directly identify OECD AI-lifecycle rights/autonomy independently of unresolved neutral-class mechanism candidates.
